item.title: Scheduler
item.description:
Development reference · Larecs 1.0.0b1 · revision 2cd6452b7bab. Host threading and device execution are experimental. Compatibility and status.

Mojo structSource

Scheduler

@memory_only
struct Scheduler[*ComponentTypes: ComponentType]

Manages the execution of systems in a world.

The systems must implement System. run initializes the systems in registration order, updates them in the same order once per step, and finalizes them after the last step.

Example:

@fieldwise_init
struct Position(Copyable, Movable):
    var x: Float64
    var y: Float64

@fieldwise_init
struct Velocity(Copyable, Movable):
    var dx: Float64
    var dy: Float64

# A system delegates filtered component processing to a kernel like this.
comptime move_filter = Filter().include[Position].read[Velocity]()

def move_entities(context: KernelContext[move_filter]):
    for entity in context:
        ref pos = entity.get[Position]()
        ref vel = entity.get[Velocity]()
        pos.x += vel.dx
        pos.y += vel.dy

@fieldwise_init
struct MySystem(System):
    var internal_variable: Int

    # This is executed once at the beginning
    def initialize(mut self, mut context: SystemContext[...]) raises:
        _ = context.world[].storage.add_entities(
            Position(0.0, 0.0), Velocity(1.0, 1.0), count=10
        )

    # This is executed in each step
    def update(mut self, mut context: SystemContext[...]) raises:
        context.run[move_entities]()

    # This is executed at the end
    def finalize(mut self, mut context: SystemContext[...]) raises:
        print("Final positions")
        for entity in context.world[].storage.query[Filter().include[Position]()]():
            print(entity.get[Position]().x, entity.get[Position]().y)
def main() raises:
    var scheduler = Scheduler[Position, Velocity]()
    scheduler.add_system(MySystem(internal_variable=42))
    scheduler.run(10)

Aliases

World

The world type used by the scheduler.

World = World[ComponentTypes]

SystemContext

The system context type used by the scheduler.

SystemContext = SystemContext[MutUntrackedOrigin, ComponentTypes]

Bound to MutUntrackedOrigin rather than a real tracked origin: the scheduler owns world itself and stores its systems type-erased (UnsafeBox plus a fixed FunctionType), so there is no single borrow of self that all of initialize/update/finalize’s calls could share – world’s origin is re-borrowed fresh on every call. world is a long-lived field of Self, never a short-lived temporary, so casting away its origin here is safe (unlike casting the origin of a ref into ResourceStorage’s Dict/UnsafeBox-backed entries, which is not).

FunctionType

The type of system functions.

FunctionType = def(mut system: UnsafeBox, mut context: SystemContext[MutUntrackedOrigin, ComponentTypes]) raises thin -> None

Parameters

  • *ComponentTypes (ComponentType): A variadic list with all possible component types for the world.

Fields

  • world (Scheduler[ComponentTypes].World): The world updated by the scheduler.

Implemented traits

AnyType, Copyable, Deinitable, Movable

run

Runs the scheduler for a given number of steps.

def run(mut self, steps: Int)

This is the main entry point for running the scheduler. It calls the initialize, update, and finalize methods in order. The update method is called steps times. The initialize method is called once at the beginning, and the finalize method is called once at the end.

Args:

  • self (Self)
  • steps (Int): The number of steps to run.

Raises:

Error: If a system’s initialize, update, or finalize implementation raises.
